_about: Precedent library (PRD FR-5, UI_REFERENCE §7). How AtliQ actually negotiated before — history, not policy. AtliQ has no fixed negotiation policy (client meeting 1), so the review shows these as context and never as hard thresholds. Sources: negotiation_notes.md (Jay's unreviewed reconstruction), meeting notes, karandeep_contract_checklist.md and the signed contracts. Quotes are verbatim.

tags.standard: What AtliQ normally asks for / accepts
tags.deliberate_exception: Accepted knowingly, for one deal only — not a new standard
tags.waved_through: Signed without real review — not a precedent to follow
tags.walked_away: AtliQ declined the deal over this term
tags.softened_for_counterparty: AtliQ as buyer softened its own paper to be fair to a small vendor

items.they_asked: LD 1% of Contract Value per week, no cap
items.atliq_agreed: 0.5% of affected milestone fee per week, max 5% of that milestone fee, no LD for client-caused delay
items.quote: K countered: 0.5% of the affected milestone fee per week of delay attributable to us, max 5% of that milestone fee, no LD for delays caused by client.

items.they_asked: LD 10% of Contract Value if go-live missed
items.atliq_agreed: 0.5%/week of milestone, cap 5% of milestone, client delays excluded
items.quote: LD 10% of Contract Value if go-live missed → K countered 0.5%/week of milestone, cap 5% of milestone, client delays excluded. Agreed.

items.they_asked: LD 2% of Contract Value per week, cap 10% of total; payment 90 days
items.atliq_agreed: 0.5% of milestone fee per week, cap 5% of milestone, client delays excluded; payment 45 days
items.quote: K: 45 days; 0.5% of milestone fee per week, cap 5% of milestone, client delays excluded. Agreed. Signed 15 Aug 2026.

items.they_asked: 1% of total fees per week, capped at 10% of total fees
items.atliq_agreed: 1% per week calculated on the milestone, aggregate cap 10% of total fees — approved as a one-off strategic exception
items.quote: K: "Approving 10% of total fees as a strategic exception for Al Noor only — not our new standard."

items.they_asked: 1% of Contract Value per day, uncapped, cumulative, no client-delay exclusion (group template, English law)
items.atliq_agreed: Signed as drafted from a phone at quarter end
items.outcome: Client caused a 19-day delay; Brightwater claimed $18,400 LD; AtliQ settled for a $9,000 credit plus $14,200 counsel fees and ~2 weeks of senior time.
items.quote: K replied from phone: "Looks standard, signing now."

items.atliq_agreed: Post-mortem: settlement agreed; no more signing on the phone
items.quote: Contract had no exclusion for client-caused delay. Their UK lawyers claimed LD of $18,400 under the delay clause.

items.they_asked: Supplier liable without limitation for all damages
items.atliq_agreed: Offered 1x fees with carve-outs; no reply — deal lost (~€120k)
items.quote: K: "No. Unlimited liability on a €120k deal means one bad incident … and the company is gone."

items.atliq_agreed: Liability capped at 1x fees, never unlimited
items.quote: liability → 1x fees. NOT unlimited

items.they_asked: AtliQ indemnifies for everything, including losses from PayTrack's own negligence
items.atliq_agreed: Mutual indemnity — each side covers its own breach/negligence; liability cap 1x fees
items.quote: K: "Can't accept 10.1 as written — we can't insure against PayTrack's own negligence."

items.atliq_agreed: Indemnity mutual; AtliQ does not cover the client's mistakes
items.quote: indemnity → mutual. we don't cover their mistakes

items.they_asked: Payment in 90 days
items.atliq_agreed: 45 days
items.quote: Their terms: payment 90 days; LD 2% of Contract Value per week, cap 10% of total.

items.atliq_agreed: Payment 30 days, 45 max
items.quote: payment → 30 days, 45 max

items.quote: K: "English law / LCIA — not worth losing the deal over. Rest looks ok, I skimmed the IP and boilerplate."

items.atliq_agreed: Accepted
items.quote: DIFC law / DIFC courts — accepted ("group standard for all technology vendors").

items.quote: Singapore law / SIAC ok.

items.they_asked: One-way NDA with 24-month no-hire and uncapped indemnity, 'standard', needed that night
items.atliq_agreed: Signed within the hour, no changes
items.quote: Bhavin: needed signing that night before a data walkthrough, "it's standard". K signed within the hour. No changes asked.

items.atliq_agreed: NDAs: sign if mutual

items.they_asked: Vendor pushed back on 1%/day delay penalty, 60-day payment, unlimited vendor liability in AtliQ's template
items.atliq_agreed: Deleted the penalty, 30-day payment, liability capped at fees for both sides (changes made in PixelCraft's copy only — template may never have been updated)
items.quote: K: "He's right. They're six people. I don't want our paper to be the thing I hate receiving." Deleted the penalty, 30-day payment, liability capped at fees for both sides.
